1-256 字符；Telegram 每次投递带 X-Telegram-Bot-A: 1-256 characters; Telegram includes it in the X-Telegram-Bot-Api-Secret-Token header on every delivery for verification
@BotFather 创建 bot 后给的 token（123456:ABC…）: The token given by @BotFather when you create a bot (123456:ABC…)
Bot API result 字段（对象/数组，按方法而定）: The Bot API result field (object or array, depending on the method)
Bot API 方法，如 sendMessage / getChat / ans: Bot API method, e.g. sendMessage / getChat / answerCallbackQuery
Bot API 的 result 随方法而变：可能是对象也可能是数组，形状由 T: The Bot API's result varies by method: it may be an object or an array, and its shape is defined by Telegram
HTTPS 地址，Telegram 将 update POST 到此: HTTPS URL that Telegram POSTs updates to
Telegram 的原始 update，形状由 Bot API 定义且随版本增补: Telegram's raw update, whose shape is defined by the Bot API and grows with new versions
Telegram 的键盘/按钮对象（inline_keyboard 等），形状由: Telegram's keyboard/button object (inline_keyboard, etc.), whose shape is defined by the Bot API
true=模态弹窗，false=顶部 toast: true = modal alert, false = top toast
原始字节，≤20MB（Bot API 下载上限）: Raw bytes, ≤20MB (the Bot API download limit)
回复的消息 ID: ID of the message being replied to
打一次 getMe，报 bot token 是否有效以及它是哪个 bot（不发消: Calls getMe once to report whether the bot token is valid and which bot it belongs to (sends no message, touches no chat)
把 Telegram 机器人接进工作流：收消息触发、发消息/图片/文件、下载用户: Connects a Telegram bot into your workflow: trigger on incoming messages, send messages/images/files, download attachments users send, or call any Bot API method directly.
新消息 id，供后续 edit/delete/reply 引用: The new message id, for later edit/delete/reply references
点击者 ID: ID of the user who clicked
该方法的参数对象（键名照 Bot API 文档）: The method's parameter object (key names follow the Bot API docs)
